what: crates/hir-ty/src/consteval.rs write_memory_map/read_memory_map: write StaticRec.id as crate::check_cache::id_bits(it.id) instead of AsId::as_id(&it.id).as_bits(), and read it with crate::check_cache::id_of::<StaticId>(it.id).ok_or(invalid("a static of salsa id index 0"))? instead of FromId::from_id(Id::from_bits). Identical outside a relocating scope (id_bits/id_of are the salsa bits there), so dependency images and the goal store are unchanged. Why: the item store (docs/v2/plan/design/item-hash.md s7) files built MIR by item key inside check_cache relocating scope; an allocation operand pointing into a static is written by write_allocation, and with raw bits its static would be another database salsa id (wrong static read back, and bytes that differ between databases). Needed by crates/hir-ty/src/mir/persist.rs.
